test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a tradesman marks his goods 25% above the cost price and allows his customers a 12% reduction on their bill, then the percentage profit he makes is ______.
solution:
**Given:**

Mark up % = 25% of CP

Discount% = 12%

**Concept used:**

Profit% = [(SP - CP)/CP] × 100

**Calculations:**

Let the CP be Rs. 100 then MP = Rs. 125

⇒ SP = 125 (1 - 12%)

⇒ SP = 125 (1 - 0.12)

⇒ SP = 125 (0.88) = Rs. 110

Now Profit%

⇒ Profit% = [(110 - 100)/100] × 100

⇒ Profit% = [10/100] × 100

⇒ Profit% = 10%

**∴ The percentage profit he makes is 10%.**
